tools.name: outlook_send_mail
tools.description: Send an HTML email via Microsoft Graph sendMail from the dedicated service mailbox — used to distribute approved maintenance completion reports, repair completion certificates, and shift handover summaries to their configured recipients once a human reviewer has approved the draft. Must only be called after the corresponding human-approval gate has been satisfied.

disclaimer_footer.description: Append the standard AI-generated-content disclaimer footer.

tools.name: outlook_get_distribution_list
tools.description: Look up the configured recipient addresses for a plant/role distribution list (e.g., 'plant-a-maintenance-engineering', 'plant-b-shift-supervisors') so a report or handover summary is sent to the correct pre-approved audience without hardcoding addresses.

tools.name: outlook_list_inbound_messages
tools.description: List inbound messages received at the service mailbox matching a sender/subject filter, for the optional inbound-ingestion path (e.g., a technician forwarding a photo or voice memo by email as an alternate submission channel).

tools.name: outlook_get_message_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve a specific attachment (e.g., a forwarded photo or vendor quote PDF) from an inbound message for downstream OCR/vision-language processing.
